name: view_mark_rune_and_effects
description: Team effects show on the creep they hold (design 3.2 and 3.7): an Owl's Eye's mark floats a gold rune over its creep while the mark lasts and the telescope follows that creep; the selection says 'marked +20%'; the rune goes when the mark lapses. A slow tints the creep frost blue and says 'slowed'; a stun circles stars over it, stops it and says 'stunned' (no tower stuns before M6: the scenario stuns the record the way the Toll Tower will).

steps.msg: no rune before the Eye marks it
the mark floats the gold rune over its creep
the Eye follows the creep it marks, and fires nothing
its telescope turns to the marked creep
the selection says it is marked, and shows the check the Thornback brings
and its armour beside its health
out of the Eye's reach the mark lapses and the rune goes with it
a slow tints it frost blue and the selection says so

steps.assert: c.effects_shown().stars and c._halo.is_visible_in_tree() and c.pace == 0.0 and node('Subtitle').text.contains('stunned')
steps.msg: a stun circles stars over it and stops it, and the selection says so
the stars go when the stun ends, and it walks on
